{
  "votes": [
    {
      "issueId": "d0659df4347117af2a5f",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "“Tamborilea” replaces the instability in “teeters” with drumming, breaking the opening image. Use “se tambalea al borde de la idiotez”: this preserves the exaggerated threat and restores immediate clarity without losing the source metaphor.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "7ff8e8babbf3a559bfb3",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“Revisemos nuestros recibos históricos” awkwardly literalizes “check our historical receipts.” The following historical examples make the intended meaning recoverable, so severity 4 overstates the damage. “Veamos qué pasó las otras veces” loses the receipt image but preserves the skeptical invitation to examine evidence.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "83cb71404951ce683853",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "In “lo corta en seco,” “lo” refers to “aprendizaje”; the source instead contrasts learning with “development.” That distinction matters to the central educational argument. “Cuándo la IA potencia el aprendizaje y cuándo interfiere en el desarrollo” restores both objects, trading the electrical metaphor for clarity.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "dcf03002302a4c3830ed",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "The source includes “date: 2025-05-31”; the candidate moves directly from “subCategory: Policy” to “modified: 2025-06-02.” This is a factual metadata omission under the preservation requirement. Restore the date; publication-system effects need not be proven to establish the omission.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "9fcd8ae6a1cd10ecf3f8",
      "verdict": "reject",
      "severity": 1,
      "reason": "The candidate declares “sourceHash: \"d5356a63e570\",” but the source contains no corresponding field or hashing convention. A difference from the packet’s comparison hash does not establish an invalid repository hash. The peer acknowledges this uncertainty, which cannot support a severity-4 defect or an automatic replacement.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "6e9f9001426f6853a1d2",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 2,
      "reason": "“The Last to Think” does not grammatically establish singular number, so “Los” is not a demonstrated perspective error. However, “Los Últimos en Pensar” uses conspicuous English-style capitalization. “Los últimos en pensar” fixes the minor presentation issue without imposing an unsupported singular interpretation.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "c3ea62f0f07d6363b888",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“Se rasga ahora las manos” fails to recreate “hand-wringing” and introduces an unintended image of injury. “¿Quién se lamenta ahora por la pérdida de la capacidad de leer mapas?” removes that distraction while retaining the rhetorical challenge. The bodily image is lost; the meaning and brisk delivery improve.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "9fc6af0a025a318f5c6e",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“Recurrir a la relojería analógica” makes “analog timekeeping” sound like a craft or industry, weakening the punch line. “No vaya a ser que tengamos que mirar un reloj de agujas” makes the action concrete while preserving the mock horror at returning to older technology.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "7c734d70524af358f442",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 2,
      "reason": "“Los años 80 vieron” is understandable personification, not inherently defective Spanish. However, “muletas que entorpecerán” weakens the bodily irony of “crutches that will hobble.” “En los años 80 se calificó a las calculadoras de «muletas que dejarán coja a una generación»” preserves that deliberate edge and improves fluency. This is minor rhetorical polish.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "473ab723a2350d38c064",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "“date: 2025-05-31” appears in the source but is absent between the candidate’s “subCategory: Policy” and “modified: 2025-06-02.” The current omission independently establishes the preservation failure; the historical regression reinforces it but is not needed. Restore the field.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "033be5af2db37c7bec95",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "“Civilization teeters” becomes “la civilización tamborilea,” changing precarious balance into drumming and damaging the opening joke. “Se tambalea” repairs the meaning. The preference for “idiotez” over “idiocia” is secondary and would not independently justify blocking.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "4630562f14e3ca0595f1",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“Se rasga ahora las manos” does not convey the anxious lament in “hand-wringing.” “¿Quién se rasga hoy las vestiduras por la pérdida de la capacidad de leer mapas?” recreates the expressive gesture. The proposed “porque ya no sabe” unnecessarily narrows the concern to the speaker’s own ability, whereas the source concerns a societal loss.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "2625792609af24672026",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“Recibos históricos” does not naturally carry the evidentiary joke in “historical receipts.” Saying the meaning disappears entirely overstates matters: the historical paragraph supplies context. “Repasemos qué dice la historia” preserves the transition and gains broad readability, at the cost of the receipt metaphor.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "b1f24f5cc27733842469",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“Cada generación descubre…” and “Surge un nuevo dispositivo…” retain the source opening’s sentence-by-sentence construction, while “tamborilea” and “relojería analógica” leave obvious adaptation problems. The requested introduction rewrite remains outstanding. Similar structure alone is not a defect, but this opening needs a natural Spanish reconstruction and an explanation of its tradeoffs.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "74ef157163fdf90096d6",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 3,
      "reason": "“—suponiendo que tenga batería.” leaves the parenthetical raya unclosed, and “relojería analógica” obscures the activity meant by “analog timekeeping.” Parentheses repair the punctuation; “mirar un reloj de agujas” restores the joke. The lexical problem merits severity 3 even though the punctuation alone is minor.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "c7fc5f85354f704e3b4a",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "“Frente a cuando lo corta en seco” both lacks the parallel interrogative accent and substitutes “aprendizaje” for the source’s “development.” Severity 2 understates the latter change to the central argument. “Cuándo la IA potencia el aprendizaje y cuándo interfiere en el desarrollo” repairs both without introducing another potentially distracting idiom.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "a40e7cb7a51c3dfb049b",
      "verdict": "reject",
      "severity": 1,
      "reason": "“Los años 80 vieron…” is intelligible temporal personification; its resemblance to “The 1980s saw…” does not establish an unacceptable anglicism. “En los años 80 se calificó…” is an available stylistic improvement, but this isolated construction is nonblocking. The separate loss of force in “entorpecerán” deserves its own assessment.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "f4b0e240229f524a56ba",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 2,
      "reason": "“Los Últimos en Pensar” and “¿Humano o Máquina?” retain English-style capitalization on ordinary words. “Los últimos en pensar” and “¿Humano o máquina?” give the headings conventional Spanish presentation. This is minor polish, with no demonstrated change in meaning.",
      "evidenceIds": ["target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "ee1b3d95ad4538698a01",
      "verdict": "reject",
      "severity": 1,
      "reason": "“sourceHash: \"d5356a63e570\"” is visible, but neither the source nor candidate defines the repository’s hashing algorithm or normalization. The cited “date: 2025-05-31” cannot establish hash validity. Staleness effects remain hypothetical, and replacing the value with the packet hash is unsupported.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    },
    {
      "issueId": "005c645f90f4c463efa3",
      "verdict": "uphold",
      "severity": 4,
      "reason": "The source has “subCategory: Policy\\ndate: 2025-05-31\\nmodified: 2025-06-02”; the candidate omits the date line. This directly violates factual metadata preservation regardless of possible date inference elsewhere. Restore “date: 2025-05-31” and retain the existing modification date.",
      "evidenceIds": ["source", "target"]
    }
  ]
}
